definitions.rationale: Macro expansion naming the exact is_palindrome statement body as an MPY AST term; it defines a named proof term and does not replace execution.
definitions.text:
rule isPalindromeBody
    => Expr(Str("Test if given string is a palindrome."))
       Return(
         Compare(
           Name("string"),
           CmpOp(
             "==",
             Subscript(
               Name("string"),
               Slice(NoBound, NoBound, UnaryOp("-", Int(1)))))))

definitions.rationale: Macro expansion naming the exact reverse-loop assignment AST; it is a structural abbreviation consumed by ordinary MPY loop execution.
definitions.text:
rule reverseLoopBody
    => Assign(
         Name("reverse_string"),
         BinOp("+", Name("char"), Name("reverse_string")))

definitions.rationale: Macro expansion naming the exact search-loop conditional and assignments as an AST term; it defines the body rather than an operational shortcut.
definitions.text:
rule searchLoopBody
    => If(
         UnaryOp("not", Name("found")),
         Assign(
           Name("prefix"),
           BinOp("+", Name("prefix"), Name("char")))
         Assign(
           Name("reverse_prefix"),
           BinOp("+", Name("char"), Name("reverse_prefix")))
         If(
           Compare(
             BinOp("+", Name("string"), Name("reverse_prefix")),
             CmpOp(
               "==",
               BinOp("+", Name("prefix"), Name("reverse_string")))),
           Assign(
             Name("result"),
             BinOp("+", Name("string"), Name("reverse_prefix")))
           Assign(Name("found"), Bool(true)),
           .Stmts),
         .Stmts)

definitions.rationale: Macro expansion naming the exact make_palindrome function body AST, including both loops and the return; fixed MPY rules execute the expanded body.
definitions.text:
rule makePalindromeBody
    => Expr(Str("Return the shortest palindrome that begins with string."))
       Assign(Name("reverse_string"), Str(""))
       Assign(Name("char"), Str(""))
       For(Name("char"), Name("string"), reverseLoopBody)
       Assign(Name("prefix"), Str(""))
       Assign(Name("reverse_prefix"), Str(""))
       Assign(
         Name("found"),
         Compare(Name("string"), CmpOp("==", Name("reverse_string"))))
       Assign(
         Name("result"),
         IfExp(
           Name("found"),
           Name("string"),
           BinOp("+", Name("string"), Name("reverse_string"))))
       For(Name("char"), Name("string"), searchLoopBody)
       Return(Name("result"))

definitions.rationale: Macro expansion defining the is_palindrome closure value from its parameter list, exact body term, and parent scope.
Macro expansion defining the make_palindrome closure value from its parameter list, exact body term, and parent scope.
Macro expansion defining the solution module AST containing the two exact function definitions; module loading remains governed by MPY semantics.
definitions.text:
rule solutionModule
    => Module(
         FuncDef(
           "is_palindrome",
           Params("string", .ParamNames),
           isPalindromeBody)
         FuncDef(
           "make_palindrome",
           Params("string", .ParamNames),
           makePalindromeBody))

definitions.rationale: Base equation for the reverseAcc mathematical summary: reversing an empty remainder returns the accumulator.
Structurally decreasing recurrence for reverseAcc that moves the input head onto the accumulator and recurses on the tail.
definitions.text:
rule reverseAcc(iCons(C:Int, R:IntSeq), A:IntSeq)
    => reverseAcc(R, iCons(C, A))

definitions.rationale: Equation defining the palIS summary as equality between a sequence and its reverseAcc reversal.
Guarded equation defining seedResult for palindromic inputs by returning the input sequence unchanged.
Complementary guarded equation defining seedResult for non-palindromic inputs as the input concatenated with its reversal.
definitions.text:
rule seedResult(S:IntSeq)
    => seqConcat(S, reverseAcc(S, .IntSeq))
    requires notBool palIS(S)

definitions.rationale: Base equation for the searchResult summary: once found is true, the accumulated result is retained.
Base equation for the searchResult summary: exhaustion of the remaining sequence returns the accumulated result.
Structurally decreasing recurrence defining one false-found searchResult step, with the source equality selecting a candidate or recursion on the tail.
definitions.text:
rule searchResult(
         S:IntSeq, iCons(C:Int, R:IntSeq), P:IntSeq, RP:IntSeq,
         REV:IntSeq, false, RESULT:IntSeq)
    => #if
         seqConcat(seqConcat(P, iCons(C, .IntSeq)), REV)
         ==K
         seqConcat(S, iCons(C, RP))
       #then
         seqConcat(S, iCons(C, RP))
       #else
         searchResult(
           S,
           R,
           seqConcat(P, iCons(C, .IntSeq)),
           iCons(C, RP),
           REV,
           false,
           RESULT)
       #fi

definitions.rationale: Equation defining completePal by initializing the searchResult summary with the input, empty prefixes, its reversal, palindrome status, and seed result.
definitions.text:
rule completePal(S:IntSeq)
    => searchResult(
         S,
         S,
         .IntSeq,
         .IntSeq,
         reverseAcc(S, .IntSeq),
         palIS(S),
         seedResult(S))
